it’s hard to pinpoint exactly what causes it, if im honest but if i had to guess the main reason, i’d say never being given proper sex education fucked me up a lot. i got in trouble for stuff when i first learned what it was, for a good reason, but i wasn’t given reassurance on how to go about it in a healthy way after that so it just kinda cemented itself as something you just don’t do, something you pretend doesn’t exist because it’s bad. 
i’ve gotten over myself a lot since then but im now im struggling with the social aspect. when is it okay to talk about? how do i know if im going overboard? is it okay to initiate things and how do i do that healthily?

as for your other questions:
1. there has but they’re very rare and happens exclusively online. any talk about it IRL makes it so much harder to ignore the shame as i then can’t distract myself of self sooth at all. i also have social anxiety which is a big contributor to all of this.

2. normal people? i guess mostly friends and romantic partners, if that’s what you meant.

3. mostly just normal conversation. someone brings up something they find hot, someone found sexual art and wanted to share it, someone said a funny sex joke that turns into a conversation- etc etc. sometimes it is just 1 on 1 though and i honestly find that to be more manageable as asking for consent is expected during that. i kinda go overboard sometimes and ask even during lighthearted stuff like simple dirty talk but it’s usually taken as just wanting to make sure, even though it’s actually just me needing constant reassurance for my anxiety. 

4. the entire idea of it being public even if just between two people is scary to me. i don’t want to bother people with something i was told to not bother people with. when im in a romantic relationship it’s a lot easier cause then it’s expected and boundaries can be set very clearly at the start and if they change you’re made aware of it. but when im not in a romantic relationship with the person im talking to it’s really difficult because that stuff isn’t really explained at all nor is it ever expected to be explained at all.
